xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2232: refactor(cloister): decompose specialists.ts (1,749 lines) into focused modules

plan.title: refactor(cloister): decompose specialists.ts (1,749 lines) into focused modules
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

metadata.docsJustification: This behavior-preserving internal module decomposition changes no documented command, configuration, API, workflow, or operator-facing surface; existing imports remain compatible through re-exports.

narratives.Problem: src/lib/cloister/specialists.ts is 1,749 lines holding six unrelated concerns (spawn/env building, specialist registry + session naming, grace periods + terminate/complete, per-project run metadata, runtime status, feedback delivery). It is baselined pipeline machinery in the quietly-regrowing cloister subtree; a change to any concern risks the others. Import surface is wide (deacon.ts, lifecycle teardown, three dashboard route modules, CLI specialists commands, 18 test files).
narratives.Proposal: Behavior-preserving barrel decomposition per the locked PRD (drafts/PAN-2232.md on overdeck-state, verified against HEAD 1df0c8ec5b with zero structure drift): move every function verbatim into six seam modules (specialists-spawn.ts, specialists-registry.ts, specialists-lifecycle.ts, specialists-project-meta.ts, specialists-status.ts, specialists-feedback.ts), each well under 1,000 lines; specialists.ts becomes a ~100-line re-export barrel so zero importers change. One seam per commit, full suite per seam (TENET-10), then a reconciliation step lowers the file-size baseline via scripts/lint-file-size.sh --update and runs scripts/lint-circular-deps.sh --update. The file is 100% module-level free functions (no class), so every seam is a pure move + re-export — no host-object delegation.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Any behavior change, rename, signature change, or visibility change (D1: pure moves only)
- Any registry schema change
- Retiring legacy specialist concepts (LegacySpecialistDefinition stays as-is)
- cloister/service.ts (PAN-2149, already landed), cloister/merge-agent.ts (PAN-2233), merge-ops.ts (PAN-2190), deacon.ts (PAN-2189)
- Adding any continue.json/state.json write (file is not a whitelisted state writer in lint-state-writes)
- Raising or adding file-size/circular-dep baseline entries manually (only --update lowering, audited)

autoDecisions.summary: Adopted the PRD's locked decisions D1-D5 verbatim (pure moves only; six named seam modules; loadRegistry/saveRegistry/migrateRegistryIfNeeded move together; private helpers move with their primary callers; bundler-cycle tolerance via npm run build per seam).
autoDecisions.rationale: The PRD is a finalized implementation brief verified against the codebase; re-verification at HEAD 1df0c8ec5b shows zero structure drift (still 1,749 lines, identical function list and order), no test source-introspects the file, PAN-2149 has landed, and both ratchet guards are live with --update support.

autoDecisions.summary: requiresInspection: true only on the first seam (wi-1-spawn), foundationFor wi-2..wi-6.
autoDecisions.rationale: The first seam crystallizes the move + barrel re-export shape that the five remaining seams replicate mechanically; a wrong shape there (logic edits, changed export style, broken barrel) would infect every subsequent seam. The rest are mechanically identical operations whose correctness is independently obvious at typecheck/build/suite.

autoDecisions.summary: Serial blocks-chain wi-1 through wi-7; readiness sequential for wi-2..wi-7.
autoDecisions.rationale: The PRD and TENET-10 mandate one seam per commit in listed order with the full suite between seams; parallel dispatch of moves in one file would conflict trivially.
